item.title: Bulgaria emerges as a surprise leader in Europe's quest for battery storage
item.description: As Europe grapples with high energy prices, supply concerns and the prospect that climate change will lead to ever hotter summers, Bulgaria's contribution towards a solution has won it the nickname the "Battery of the Balkans".
item.dc:creator: Alex Lefkowitz, Angeliki Koutantou
item.content:encoded: As Europe grapples with high energy prices, supply concerns and the prospect that climate change will lead to ever hotter summers, Bulgaria's contribution towards a solution has won it the nickname the "Battery of the Balkans". Helped by €700 million ($783.86 million) in European Union grants, the Black Sea country has doubled its battery capacity over the last year, allowing it to store solar energy produced in the day and release it during peak hours in the evening. That enabled a significant rise in power exports that supplied neighbouring countries when heatwaves in July and August left national grids struggling to cope with demand. "Battery storage is critical now. It’s not a nice to have, it’s a must have," said Nikola Gazdov, chairman of industry body the Association for Production, Storage and Trading of Electricity, or APSTE for short. European Union countries have for years sought to develop battery storage to balance the intermittent nature of solar and wind energy. Progress has been delayed by long waits for regulatory approvals and grid connections, although [USN:L6N42U0QP TEXT:"adoption is expected to pick up"], especially in Germany, the UK and Italy. The events of this year, when high energy prices have added to grievances that have provoked [USN:L1N4610U5 TEXT:"social unrest"] have focused minds further. Success in storing power for when it is most needed helps to determine how much customers pay for electricity and to cushion the impact of the disruption linked to the US-Israeli war on Iran. LEAP IN BULGARIAN POWER EXPORTS Bulgaria has only limited amounts of domestic oil and gas, and its electricity output is dwarfed by many other EU countries. But it succeeded in increasing its power exports by 62% this year from last year, APSTE figures show, to 3.5 terawatt-hours after EU grants and regulatory changes helped to draw in private investment to its battery storage. Its storage capacity is now around 6 gigawatts, up from 3 GW a year ago. Some of the exports went to Romania, which was forced to shut a [USN:S8N3YR00M TEXT:"nuclear reactor"] in August after a drought that reduced the levels of the Danube River whose waters are used to cool reactor turbines. Apart from the exports' value, the increase in battery power also helped Romania to maintain reservoir levels by reducing its need to use hydropower, traditionally used to meet peak demand. Bulgaria has exported as much as 50,000 megawatt-hours of electricity per day, said Dimitar Zarchev, head of Central Dispatch Management at Bulgaria's Electricity System Operator. "To put that into perspective, that works out to an average of around 2,000 megawatts flowing out of Bulgaria every hour — roughly equivalent to the output of the Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant.” The plant is located in northwestern Bulgaria. BENEFIT GREATEST IN SUMMER The batteries are expected to have less impact in winter when reduced daylight hours mean less solar power. Zarchev expects over the coming winter months that Bulgaria will have to rely more on conventional power plants than stored renewable power. Further increases in battery storage also face other issues, including the need for Bulgaria to expand its grid. The pace of the scale-up has also eroded some of the financial incentives that drew investors as price spreads have narrowed, reducing the amount of revenue to be made from the gap between the price when power is stored and when it is discharged. "At some point, batteries may begin to cannibalise part of their revenues," Bulgaria's Energy Ministry said in a statement to Reuters. "It will then become even more important for them to participate not just in simple arbitrage between cheap and expensive hours, but also in balancing markets and system services". BULGARIA OUTPACES GREECE Greece, known for its many months of sunshine, looked like a natural leader in the battery race. While its solar capacity has grown significantly, more than tripling between 2020 and 2025, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency, its battery storage is lagging and the country depends on imported gas to meet peak evening demand. Despite three rounds of auctions for standalone batteries since 2023, Greece only installed a first chunk in April. Total storage is expected to reach one gigawatt by the end of the year, a small fraction of Bulgaria's capacity, according to government figures. Greek retail electricity excluding taxes and levies averaged €0.1967 per kilowatt-hour in the first half of the year, compared to €0.1117 for Bulgaria, data from the EU statistics service Eurostat showed. The Greek energy ministry said in a presentation last month it was working to speed up storage with the help of EU funds to try to lower [USN:L6N4600MT TEXT:"energy prices"]. Officials have said another 5 GW of battery capacity is expected to come online by 2030, in addition to the GW expected to be online by the end of this year. For some that is not soon enough. "If we had had those six gigawatts operating now, our power system would have been more balanced and this would have passed on to consumers," Manolis Karapidakis, the chief executive officer of the Greek association of power storage developers, told Reuters. ($1 = 0.8930 euros)

item.title: 韓国、北朝鮮に軍事会談を再提案 地雷爆発受け
item.description: [ソウル ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２３日 ロイター] - 韓国国防省は２３日、北朝鮮に軍事会談を改めて提案した。南北間の陸上境界線の正確な位置について合意し、偶発的な衝突のリスクを減らすことが狙い。

９月に非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で地雷が爆発し、韓国軍兵士が負傷したことを受けたもので、キム・ホンチョル国防政策室長が発表した。

北朝鮮軍は近年、南北を隔てるＤＭＺ内の軍事境界線付近で、軍用道路やフェンスの建設、地雷の敷設を進めている。

キム氏によると、北朝鮮軍の兵士はこうした作業の過程で軍事境界線を越えていたという。

国防省は２０２５年１１月にも、境界線の位置を巡る認識の相違を解消するため会談を提案したが、北朝鮮は応じていない。

韓国軍は、９月に兵士２人が重傷を負った爆発の原因となった地雷について、北朝鮮が軍事境界線の南側に埋設したものと断定。北朝鮮側はこれを否定している。

item.title: Saudi Arabia postpones UN data forum, Saudi statistical event to 2027
item.description: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics has postponed the United Nations World Data Forum and the Second Saudi Statistical Forum, previously scheduled for November 9 to 12, 2026, in Riyadh, to 2027, it said in a statement on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics has postponed the United Nations World Data Forum and the Second Saudi Statistical Forum, previously scheduled for November 9 to 12, 2026, in Riyadh, to 2027, it said in a statement on Friday. The move follows Saudi Arabia's decision on Monday to delay its [USN:L6N46511F TEXT:"flagship investment conference"] to 2027, after deadly attacks in recent weeks linked to the widening Middle East conflict disrupted business activity. The Future Investment Initiative had been due to take place from October 26 to 29. The authority said it postponed the UN data forum and the Saudi statistical forum to ensure broad international participation by speakers, experts and partners, and the delivery of an event that meets the expectations of the global data and statistics community. Several other major events in Saudi Arabia, including [USN:L1N4600SG TEXT:"the Six Kings Slam tennis tournament"] and the World Rally Championship's Saudi Arabia round, have also been cancelled or postponed amid escalating attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis. The US-Israeli war with Iran this year has disrupted the Gulf's events calendar, prompting the cancellation, postponement or restructuring of several conferences in the UAE and Qatar, which were more heavily affected by attacks than Saudi Arabia in the first part of the year.

item.title: US military bans BYD vehicles from strategic air base in Japan
item.description: The US military said on Friday it will ban vehicles made by Chinese EV maker BYD from an air base in Japan, saying their presence posed a security risk.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US military said on Friday it will ban vehicles made by Chinese EV maker BYD (002594.SZ) from an air base in Japan, saying their presence posed a security risk. The ban will begin at the Kadena Air Base on Japan's Okinawa island on Monday, the Yonhap newswire reported earlier. The base is a major US air power hub on Japan's strategic southwest island chain running along the edge of the East China Sea. "These vehicles present an unacceptable and unmitigable risk to our personnel and our mission," base spokesperson Lieutenant Colonel Alli Stormer said. She did not say what specific concern had prompted the commander to act against the Chinese electric vehicles. BYD did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Chinese company, which overtook Tesla as the world’s biggest seller of battery-electric vehicles in 2025, is expanding overseas, including in Japan. It launched its Racco electric minicar there in July as it seeks a foothold in a market dominated by domestic brands. The Pentagon in June designated BYD, along with e-commerce firm Alibaba (9988.HK) , internet company Baidu and automaker NIO, as companies it believes support China's military. BYD rejected the designation and said it would pursue administrative and legal avenues to protect its interests. China has imposed similar restrictions on Tesla vehicles. In 2021 it barred them from some government compounds due to security concerns over cameras installed on the vehicles. Beijing removed that restriction in 2024 after Tesla won an endorsement from the country's top auto industry association.

item.title: China's DeepSeek, MiniMax win approval for AI global use, state media-affiliated entity says
item.description: Major Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax have won state approval for global use of their AI models, according to a post on Thursday on a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster CCTV.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Major Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax (0100.HK) have won state approval for global use of their AI models, according to a post on Thursday on a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster CCTV. In a separate social media post on Friday, the social media account, Yuyuan Tantian, said overseas internet users had also urged other Chinese open-source large language models to follow suit. DeepSeek and MiniMax did not immediately reply to requests for comment. China [USN:L1N46209C TEXT:"proposed"] export controls on 23 AI technologies on October 16, including those involving models, agents and computing clusters. China's commerce ministry said then, though, that most AI technologies would remain exportable, with simplified licensing for open-source technology exports and Chinese companies operating their own computing centres overseas. The proposed export controls cover overseas deployment of AI models containing restricted technology and were Beijing's latest move to limit the transfer of tools it views as vital to national security amid geopolitical competition with Washington.

item.title: Dax tiefer erwartet - Konjunktur und Frankreich im Blick
item.description: Der Dax wird am Freitag der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Verlusten in den Handel starten. Sorgen über den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und steigende Ölpreise hatten die Anleger am Donnerstag verunsichert und den Index 1,1 Prozent niedriger bei 25.371 Punkten schließen lassen. An den US-Börsen setzte sich der Ausverkauf bei Tech-Aktien fort. Die Erleichterung nach starken Quartalszahlen von US-Technologiefirmen wie Meta und SpaceX verpuffte schnell, da die hohen Kosten für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) wieder in den Fokus der Anleger rückten. Auf die Stimmung drückten zudem erneute Turbulenzen am französischen Anleihemarkt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Der Dax (.GDAXI) wird am Freitag der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Verlusten in den Handel starten. Sorgen über den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und steigende Ölpreise hatten die Anleger am [USN:L8N46828X TEXT:"Donnerstag"] verunsichert und den Index 1,1 Prozent niedriger bei 25.371 Punkten schließen lassen. An den [USN:L8N4682FJ TEXT:"US-Börsen"] (.DJI) (.SPX) (.IXIC) setzte sich der Ausverkauf bei Tech-Aktien fort. Die Erleichterung nach starken Quartalszahlen von US-Technologiefirmen wie Meta (META.O) und SpaceX (SPCX.O) verpuffte schnell, da die hohen Kosten für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) wieder in den Fokus der Anleger rückten. Auf die Stimmung drückten zudem erneute [USN:L8N4680NI TEXT:"Turbulenzen"] am französischen Anleihemarkt. Am Freitag blicken Anleger weiter auf die Entwicklungen in Frankreich. Die Ratingagentur Moody's überprüft die französische Kreditwürdigkeit. Eine Herabstufung könnte die Risikoaufschläge französischer Staatsanleihen weiter erhöhen und damit auch den Euro sowie europäische Banken belasten. Zudem werden die Einkaufsmanagerindizes (PMI) für die Euro-Zone veröffentlicht. Besonderes Augenmerk dürfte auf den Ergebnissen für Frankreich liegen. Auf der Unternehmensseite kommen die IG Metall und Volkswagen in Hannover zusammen, um den Zukunftstarifvertrag von 2024 zum zweiten Mal zu überprüfen. Schlusskurse europäischer Aktien-Indizes und

item.title: Trump stuft Import von Windkraftanlagen als Gefahr für US-Sicherheit ein
item.description: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat den Import von Windkraftanlagen und deren Bauteilen als Bedrohung für die nationale Sicherheit eingestuft. Er verzichtete am Donnerstag (Ortszeit) jedoch vorerst auf neue Handelsbeschränkungen wie Zölle. Stattdessen wies er Handelsvertreter an, Verhandlungen mit den Partnerländern aufzunehmen und innerhalb von 180 Tagen Bericht zu erstatten. Weitere Maßnahmen könnten später folgen, teilte das Weiße Haus mit. Einer Untersuchung des Handelsministeriums zufolge gefährden die Anlagen die Sicherheit durch Cyberrisiken bei ausländischen Geräten, Störungen von Radarsystemen und eine zunehmende Abhängigkeit vom Ausland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat den Import von Windkraftanlagen und deren Bauteilen als Bedrohung für die nationale Sicherheit eingestuft. Er verzichtete am Donnerstag (Ortszeit) jedoch vorerst auf neue Handelsbeschränkungen wie Zölle. Stattdessen wies er Handelsvertreter an, Verhandlungen mit den Partnerländern aufzunehmen und innerhalb von 180 Tagen Bericht zu erstatten. Weitere Maßnahmen könnten später folgen, teilte das Weiße Haus mit. Einer Untersuchung des Handelsministeriums zufolge gefährden die Anlagen die Sicherheit durch Cyberrisiken bei ausländischen Geräten, Störungen von Radarsystemen und eine zunehmende Abhängigkeit vom Ausland. Trump bekräftigte in dem Erlass seine langjährige Kritik, dass Windenergie unzuverlässig sei und das US-Stromnetz belaste. Der Schritt geht auf eine im vergangenen Jahr eingeleitete Untersuchung der US-Regierung zu den Auswirkungen von Importen auf die nationale Sicherheit zurück. Zu den wichtigsten Lieferanten von Windkraftanlagen und Komponenten für die USA gehören, Daten der Denkfabrik American Action Forum zufolge, neben Mexiko und Indien auch europäische Länder wie Deutschland, Dänemark und Frankreich.

item.title: El terremoto en el Tíbet deja 16 fallecidos y 65 heridos
item.description: El número de heridos en el terremoto de magnitud 7 que sacudió la región suroeste del Tíbet chino ha ascendido a 65, informó el viernes el gobierno local en una publicación en las redes sociales, mientras que el número de fallecidos se mantuvo sin cambios en 16.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El número de heridos en [USN:L6N46815F TEXT:"el terremoto"] de magnitud 7 que sacudió la región suroeste del Tíbet chino ha ascendido a 65, informó el viernes el gobierno local en una publicación en las redes sociales, mientras que el número de fallecidos se mantuvo sin cambios en 16. El terremoto, cuyo epicentro se situó en Nagqu, una ciudad de gran altitud y escasa densidad de población situada en el norte del Tíbet, es el más fuerte que ha sacudido China desde enero de 2024. Más de 300 agentes de policía, entre ellos personal de tráfico y de policía comunitaria, fueron enviados al epicentro para llevar a cabo labores de rescate y ayuda de emergencia, informó el departamento de policía de Nagqu en otra publicación en la aplicación de mensajería WeChat a primera hora del viernes. Los agentes enviados a la región evaluaron los daños en las viviendas y ayudaron a la población a trasladarse a lugares más seguros, indicó también la policía de Nagqu en la publicación de WeChat. Un video publicado por la policía en Douyin, la aplicación hermana de TikTok, mostraba a los agentes cargando suministros en un camión en la oscuridad e inspeccionando un edificio y los escombros con linternas. Más de 12.000 personas han sido realojadas de forma segura, según la agencia estatal de noticias Xinhua. Los videos difundidos anteriormente por medios de comunicación oficiales locales mostraban a personas abandonando sus hogares y buscando refugio al aire libre o en sus vehículos aparcados en la calle. Un residente contó que se despertó por el fuerte sismo y que oyó cómo crujía la casa durante el temblor. El Centro de Redes Sísmicas de China indicó en un comunicado que se habían registrado 413 réplicas. En 2010, un terremoto de magnitud 7,1 sacudió Yushu, en la vecina provincia de Qinghai, causando la muerte de al menos 2.698 personas y dejando a casi 300 desaparecidos.

item.title: Indonesia energy ministry to consider additional quota for subsidised fuel as demand rises
item.description: Indonesia's energy minister said on Friday that he was considering requesting an additional subsidised fuel quota for this year as consumers look for cheaper options.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indonesia's energy minister said on Friday that he was considering requesting an additional subsidised fuel quota for this year as consumers look for cheaper options. The ministry is calculating a possible increase in the distribution of 90-octane gasoline, known as Pertalite, as buyers shift away from 92-octane fuel, which is not subsidised, Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia told reporters. The additional volume and subsidy costs are still being calculated, he said. The government has pledged to keep the subsidised fuel price unchanged until the end of the year. The government has allocated 29.27 million kilolitres of Pertalite for distribution this year. By August 20, 18.23 million kilolitres had been sold, data from downstream oil and gas regulator BPH Migas showed. Since the price of non-subsidised fuel rose in early June, average daily consumption of Pertalite has been around 10% higher, BPH Migas data showed. Indonesia's Ombudsman said earlier this month that [USN:L6N4620HD TEXT:"fuel supply disruptions"] have been reported across several provinces, including Bali, North Sulawesi, West Sulawesi, Southeast Sulawesi, West Papua, and West Kalimantan, with vehicle queues stretching to around 1 km (0.6 miles) in several locations.

item.title: William Hill owner Evoke's Q3 revenue falls on UK shop closures, unfavourable sports results
item.description: British betting and gaming company Evoke on Friday reported a 2% fall in third-quarter revenue, on a like-for-like constant currency basis, weighed down by store closures and unfavourable sports results early in the football season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British betting and gaming company Evoke (EVOK.L) on Friday reported a 2% fall in third-quarter revenue, on a like-for-like constant currency basis, weighed down by store closures and unfavourable sports results early in the football season. Here are some details: The company, which owns betting brands such as William Hill, 888 and Mr Green, reported a revenue of £406 million ($543.51 million) for the quarter ended September 30 Sports outcomes that resulted in higher payouts to winning betters at the start of the football season trimmed revenue growth by about 1 to 2 percentage points year-on-year, Evoke said In March, Evoke said it would [USN:L6N40J1FZ TEXT:"shut"] a number of betting shops following tax hikes announced last year CEO Per Widerström said the closure of 270 shops over the past year "shows the real impact on jobs and livelihoods from higher industry taxation" Evoke urged the UK government to carefully consider any further tax increases ahead of its upcoming autumn budget The debt-laden company agreed to be [USN:L4N42D0H1 TEXT:"acquired"] by Greek lottery and gaming firm Bally's Intralot (BYLOTr.AT) in June ($1 = 0.7470 pounds)

item.title: Saab-Le bénéfice dépasse les attentes au T3, porté par le réarmement
item.description: Saab a annoncé vendredi une hausse supérieure aux attentes de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, le groupe suédois de défense et d'aérospatiale citant une forte hausse de ses ventes, alors qu'il continue de surfer sur la vague du réarmement mondial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Saab (SAABb.ST) a annoncé vendredi une hausse supérieure aux attentes de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, le groupe suédois de défense et d'aérospatiale citant une forte hausse de ses ventes, alors qu'il continue de surfer sur la vague du réarmement mondial. Le résultat d'exploitation du constructeur de l'avion de chasse Gripen a atteint 1,95 milliard de couronnes (175,72 millions d'euros), contre 1,37 milliard un an plus tôt, alors que les analystes interrogés par LSEG tablaient en moyenne sur 1,91 milliard. "Les perspectives à long terme du marché restent favorables", a déclaré le directeur général Micael Johansson dans un communiqué. "Grâce à un portefeuille solide, un carnet de commandes record, une capacité de production en expansion et des investissements continus dans les capacités futures, nous sommes bien placés pour atteindre nos objectifs financiers", a-t-il ajouté. Saab, qui fabrique également du matériel militaire allant des missiles et de l’électronique de pointe aux sous-marins, a indiqué dans un communiqué que son chiffre d’affaires à périmètre constant avait progressé de 30,6% par rapport à l’année précédente. Déjà porté depuis plusieurs années par une demande en forte hausse, alimentée par le réarmement rapide d’une grande partie de l’Europe face à la guerre menée par la Russie en Ukraine, Saab a vu cette dynamique s’accélérer encore cette année avec une série de commandes majeures. Saab, qui rivalise avec des géants comme Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) , Dassault Aviation (AM.PA) et BAE Systems (BAES.L) , a annoncé que ses prises de commandes avaient bondi de 216% sur un an au cours du trimestre, dont une commande ukrainienne d’avions de combat Gripen d’un montant de 24,6 milliards de couronnes suédoises.

item.title: EEUU dice celebrar los avances en las conversaciones de reconciliación política en Venezuela
item.description: El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos dijo el jueves que acogía con satisfacción la conclusión de la tercera ronda de conversaciones de reconciliación política entre la Asamblea Nacional de Venezuela de 2015 y el Gobierno interino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos dijo el jueves que acogía con satisfacción la conclusión de la tercera ronda de conversaciones de reconciliación política entre la Asamblea Nacional de Venezuela de 2015 y el Gobierno interino. El Departamento de Estado señaló que el proceso "sigue fortaleciendo las instituciones democráticas" y "sienta las bases para unas elecciones libres, justas y creíbles" en el país sudamericano. Estados Unidos sigue instando a la liberación inmediata de todos los presos políticos en Venezuela, dijo el portavoz del Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, en un comunicado.

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べて小幅にドル高／円安の１５６円後半で推移している。朝方は円買いが優勢で一時１５６．０８円まで下落したが、昼前にかけて１５７円前半まで切り返した。実質的な五・十日に当たり、輸入企業によるドル買いが入ったとみられている。実需の取引が一巡した午後は１５７円近辺で小動きが続いた。

朝方は日経平均が１０００円超安に下げ幅を拡大する中、リスク回避の円買いが優勢となった。全国消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で総合、コア、コア・コアのいずれも２％を上回り、日銀による利上げへの思惑も円買いを後押しした。

ただ、ドル／円は１５６円近辺で下げ止まり、一段安とはならなかった。５週間ぶりの安値圏に下落したこともあり、実需の買いが入りやすい地合いだった。

市場からは「株価が落ち着きを取り戻し、もう一段下を攻める材料に欠いた。一目均衡表の雲下限も下値のサポートとして意識されたのではないか」（みなと銀行の苅谷将吾ストラテジスト）との見方が出ていた。

午後は動意に乏しい展開となった。来週の日米中銀による金融政策イベントを控え、様子見ムードが強まりやすかった。

item.title: China's Chery expects overseas-manufactured vehicles to top 50% of exports, exec says
item.description: Chery expects more than half of the vehicles it exports to be made overseas by the end of this year, with the share rising to 60% next year and 70% by 2030, Executive Vice President Zhang Guibing said on Friday at an event.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chery (9973.HK) expects more than half of the vehicles it exports to be made overseas by the end of this year, with the share rising to 60% next year and 70% by 2030, Executive Vice President Zhang Guibing said on Friday at an event. Here are some more details: Zhang said overseas manufactured vehicles account for about 48% of its export volume this year Zhang said the company is pursuing local manufacturing not only to sell vehicles but also to create jobs and "cooperate with local technologies" "Step by step, we are trying to localize production and rely mainly on local manufacturing," he told an event in Chery's headquarters in Wuhu [USN:L6N4670KL TEXT:"Chery"], which sells the Omoda and Jaecoo brands, is one of several Chinese automakers disrupting the global auto industry with advanced technology and prices that legacy car companies have struggled to match The company said it will start building fast-charging and energy storage stations in countries including UK, Spain and Thailand from 2027 and will launch robotaxis first in UAE from next year

item.title: Fiji pitches pride over money in bid to lure Nawaqanitawase
item.description: Fiji has no chance of matching the financial rewards Australia can offer Mark Nawaqanitawase but the nation's rugby union hopes the lure of representing his ancestral homeland will persuade the dual international to wear the Flying Fijians jersey at next year's World Cup.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: Fiji has no chance of matching the financial rewards Australia can offer Mark Nawaqanitawase but the nation's rugby union hopes the lure of representing his ancestral homeland will persuade the dual international to wear the Flying Fijians jersey at next year's World Cup. With Nawaqanitawase weighing up his international future, Fiji Rugby Union Chairman John Sanday made an emotional pitch to the former Wallabies winger in an interview with Reuters, stressing identity, belonging and the opportunity to inspire a small Pacific nation. "We will never be able to offer the financial and the marketing rewards that playing for the Wallabies would offer Mark, but we would offer something that goes deeper," Sanday said. "It's about identity. It's about who we are, and we are Fijians. "We come from a tiny little island, a speck in the vast Pacific Ocean, but we are punching above our weight in the global rugby hemisphere." Nawaqanitawase finished up his spell with the Sydney Roosters after his tries helped them to the National Rugby League title earlier this month and is returning to the 15-man game on a two-year deal with Japanese club Wild Knights. Wallabies coach Les Kiss is keen to secure Nawaqanitawase for the World Cup but the winger declined to be part of the team's [USN:L6N46905O TEXT:"squad for the Nations Championship"] tests and said he would not make a decision until next year. The 26-year-old, who also has Italian heritage, told a podcast this week that the chance of success in his next endeavour was a bigger motivator than money. "I still have more to prove. I don't know where that's going to be, but wherever I go, I feel like I have a lot to give the team," he told 'The Good, the Bad & the Rugby' podcast. "Whoever it's for, I want to go and win it." Nawaqanitawase also spoke warmly of his Fijian upbringing, recalling a household buzzing with visiting Fijian relatives and annual school holiday trips to his ancestral village. "I grew up in the village running around playing touch, whether it was with a coconut or a bottle, playing volleyball or just swimming in the river," he said. Sanday said those connections could prove decisive in his next move. "He is one of us. He's a Fijian. He has a village where his father is from. He has a tribe and a clan to where he belongs," he said. "Yes, he's Australian. We respect that, and if he chooses to go for Australia, of course, we will always respect that. I'd say that we would like to see him come and just play a year for us, and then he can go back to the Aussies."

item.title: En su bastión de Iowa, Trump insta a los republicanos a acudir a las urnas
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, intentó el jueves movilizar a los votantes republicanos en Iowa, un estado en el que ganó por un margen de dos dígitos hace dos años, pero en el que ahora se enfrenta a una contienda más reñida en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre debido al descontento por el aumento de los precios y la guerra con Irán.
item.dc:creator: Nandita Bose
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, intentó el jueves movilizar a los votantes republicanos en Iowa, un estado en el que ganó por un margen de dos dígitos hace dos años, pero en el que ahora se enfrenta a una contienda más reñida en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre debido al descontento por el aumento de los precios y la guerra con Irán. Esta parada en el Medio Oeste forma parte de la campaña de Trump por los estados en los que los republicanos suelen esperar ganar, pero donde las encuestas apuntan a unos reñidos resultados. Trump celebró un mitin en Sioux City, donde los republicanos defienden un escaño en el Senado, tres distritos de la Cámara de Representantes y la gobernación, lo que da una oportunidad a los demócratas tras años de avances republicanos. "Imaginen que yo estoy en la papeleta, porque si salen a votar, vamos a ganar por goleada", dijo Trump a la multitud reunida en un hangar del aeropuerto. Ha hablado en repetidas ocasiones con confianza sobre su conexión con los votantes, aunque su índice de aprobación ha caído y algunos republicanos a los que Trump está tratando de ayudar han roto con él por la guerra de Irán, mientras que el aumento de los precios del combustible y los alimentos agrava las preocupaciones económicas de los votantes. La congresista republicana Ashley Hinson, que también intervino en el mitin de Sioux City, ha pedido el "fin inmediato" de la guerra, afirmando que los habitantes de Iowa no deberían tener que soportar precios más altos del combustible ni de los alimentos a causa de ella. Se encuentra inmersa en una reñida contienda por el Senado contra el diputado estatal demócrata Josh Turek. "Si perdemos este escaño aquí en Iowa, los demócratas controlarán el Senado de Estados Unidos. Recuerden mis palabras", afirmó el jueves. Los congresistas republicanos Mariannette Miller-Meeks y Zach Nunn, que se enfrentan a difíciles campañas de reelección, se unieron el mes pasado a los demócratas para votar a favor de limitar los poderes bélicos de Trump en Irán. "Lo único que le está perjudicando más que nada son los precios del combustible", dijo Ron Sitzmann, de 73 años, asistente al mitin y director de recambios y servicio semijubilado de una empresa automovilística de Iowa, quien añadió que creía que los precios bajarían una vez que terminara el conflicto. "Solo deseo que ocurra más pronto que tarde, porque se está alargando un poco", dijo Sitzmann, que sigue siendo un firme partidario de Trump.

item.title: Electrolux-Résultat opérationnel au-dessus des attentes au T3 avec les réductions de coûts
item.description: Le fabricant suédois d'appareils électroménagers Electrolux a fait état vendredi d'un résultat opérationnel supérieur aux attentes au troisième trimestre, citant l'impact positif des économies réalisées bien que mettant en garde contre la persistance des coûts élevés liés aux matières premières et à la logistique.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le fabricant suédois d'appareils électroménagers Electrolux (ELUXb.ST) a fait état vendredi d'un résultat opérationnel supérieur aux attentes au troisième trimestre, citant l'impact positif des économies réalisées bien que mettant en garde contre la persistance des coûts élevés liés aux matières premières et à la logistique. "La pression concurrentielle est restée forte, parallèlement à d'importants facteurs de coût défavorables liés à des éléments externes, notamment les matières premières, les coûts logistiques et les droits de douane américains", a observé le président-directeur général, Yannick Fierling, cité dans un communiqué. Le résultat d'exploitation ajusté trimestriel s'est établi à 912 millions de couronnes suédoises (82,03 millions d'euros), alors que les analystes attendaient en moyenne 867 millions selon un sondage réalisé par l'entreprise. La prudence des consommateurs et la hausse des coûts liée au conflit au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les droits de douane américains, ont pesé sur Electrolux, contraignant l’entreprise à rechercher des économies, notamment par des suppressions d’emplois. L'entreprise a indiqué que les craintes liées à l'inflation continuaient d'ébranler la confiance des consommateurs en Amérique du Nord, une région qui a représenté 35% du chiffre d'affaires du groupe au cours du trimestre. Yannick Fierling a précisé que les clients de la région s'étaient tournés vers des "gammes de prix plus basses". Le chiffre d'affaires dans la région a progressé de 2%, mais cette hausse est principalement due à des augmentations de prix, a précisé Electrolux. La [USN:L8N45K0SH TEXT:"confiance des consommateurs"] aux États-Unis est tombée à son plus bas niveau depuis 2014, selon une enquête publiée en septembre, sous la pression de taux d’intérêt élevés, de la hausse des prix de l’énergie et du coût de la vie.

item.title: 国内金融システム、海外市場・ファンドの影響受けやすくなっている可能性＝日銀リポート
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日銀は２３日に公表した金融システムリポートで、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
国内金融システム、海外市場・ファンドの影響受けやすくなっている可能性＝日銀リポート 15:35 配信

日銀本店。２０２４年３月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日銀は２３日に公表した金融システムリポートで、国内の金融システムは「全体として安定性を維持」していると評価した。同時に海外ノンバンクの影響拡大を指摘し「グローバルな金融市場の変動や海外ファンドの動向の影響を受けやすくなっている可能性」があると指摘した。

足元の金融活動については「大きな不均衡は認められないが、不動産価格や株価といった資産価格の動向には引き続き留意が必要」とした。首都圏マンション市場の関連では「空室率の低下と賃料の上昇が続いている」とする一方で、「都心３区に限ると中古マンションの価格上昇に一服感もみられる」と記述した。

日銀は年２回、金融システム全体の状況についての分析・評価を行うリポートを公表している。

＊この記事はこの後更新します。

item.title: German home prices stagnate as interest rates pressure market, IW data show
item.description: German home prices hardly rose in the third quarter, according to data released on Friday by the German Economic Institute (IW), as higher interest rates weigh on purchases.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German home prices hardly rose in the third quarter, according to data released on Friday by the German Economic Institute (IW), as higher interest rates weigh on purchases. Apartment prices rose 0.3% from a year earlier, while single-family homes and duplexes rose 0.4%. "Prices have largely been moving sideways since 2023 and are down 10% from their 2022 peak," IW said. The data come ahead of official third-quarter figures from Germany's statistics office, which are due on December 23. Official data showed home prices [USN:L8N45G0CN TEXT:"rose slightly"] in the second quarter. "Due to higher financing costs, demand for properties for sale has declined, which is why prices have essentially remained stagnant," IW said.

item.title: Baubranche meldet Rekordplus im Neugeschäft durch Großaufträge
item.description: Die deutsche Bauwirtschaft hat im August ein Rekordplus im Neugeschäft erzielt. Der Auftragseingang im Bauhauptgewerbe wuchs um 23,0 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vormonat, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Freitag mitteilte. "Bedingt durch mehrere Großaufträge war dies der höchste saisonbereinigte Anstieg zum Vormonat im Bauhauptgewerbe seit Beginn der Zeitreihe im Jahr 1991", hieß es dazu. Im weniger schwankungsanfälligen Dreimonatsvergleich zeigt sich ebenfalls ein deutlicher Anstieg: Von Juni bis August zog der Auftragseingang um 7,6 Prozent über dem Niveau der drei Monate zuvor.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die deutsche Bauwirtschaft hat im August ein Rekordplus im Neugeschäft erzielt. Der Auftragseingang im Bauhauptgewerbe wuchs um 23,0 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vormonat, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Freitag mitteilte. "Bedingt durch mehrere Großaufträge war dies der höchste saisonbereinigte Anstieg zum Vormonat im Bauhauptgewerbe seit Beginn der Zeitreihe im Jahr 1991", hieß es dazu. Im weniger schwankungsanfälligen Dreimonatsvergleich zeigt sich ebenfalls ein deutlicher Anstieg: Von Juni bis August zog der Auftragseingang um 7,6 Prozent über dem Niveau der drei Monate zuvor. Die Bestellungen im Hochbau legten im August um 12,4 Prozent zu. Der Tiefbau - der von staatlichen Aufträgen etwa für den Straßenbau geprägt ist - meldete sogar ein Plus von 31,6 Prozent. Die Branche hofft auf das Sondervermögen für Infrastruktur und Klimaneutralität der Bundesregierung. In der Breite kämen die Mittel daraus bislang jedoch kaum an, kritisierten Verbände zuletzt. Auch der Umsatz legte im August zu. Er stieg um 10,1 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vorjahresmonat auf 10,9 Milliarden Euro. Inflationsbereinigt bleibt davon ein Plus von 4,9 Prozent übrig. Die Zahl der im Bauhauptgewerbe tätigen Personen nahm um 1,5 Prozent auf rund 548.000 Personen zu. Alle Angaben beziehen sich auf Betriebe von Unternehmen mit 20 und mehr tätigen Personen. Wirtschaftsverbände haben zuletzt politische Reformen gefordert, um insbesondere den Wohnungsbau anzukurbeln. "Die Wohnungsbauförderung ist für die Bundesregierung der günstigste Weg, die Konjunktur anzukurbeln", sagte der Hauptgeschäftsführer des Zentralverbandes des Deutschen Baugewerbes (ZDB), Felix Pakleppa, kürzlich. "Wer Wohneigentum fördert, entlastet angespannte Mietmärkte, stärkt die heimische Wirtschaft und zeigt den Bürgern, dass er ihre Sorgen ernst nimmt."

item.title: Taiwan says China using militia boats to expand 'battlefield preparation' in western Pacific
item.description: China is combining militia vessels with coast guard ships to expand "battlefield preparation" around Taiwan and into the western Pacific, Taiwan's Coast Guard said, warning the operations were also putting pressure on Japan and the Philippines.
item.dc:creator: Yimou Lee, Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: China is combining militia vessels with coast guard ships to expand "battlefield preparation" around Taiwan and into the western Pacific, Taiwan's Coast Guard said, warning the operations were also putting pressure on Japan and the Philippines. Responding to a [USN:L4N45S05G TEXT:"Reuters exclusive"] this month on the first known sighting of a Chinese militia boat off Taiwan's Pacific coast in mid-August, the coast guard said it had dispatched a patrol boat to drive away the vessel, which was operating alongside a Chinese coast guard ship and a research vessel. The coast guard confirmed details in the Reuters report, identifying the suspected militia fishing boat as Minfudingyu 07902, and said it had come as close as about 2.7 nautical miles outside Taiwan's restricted waters on August 16. China has increased such activity since June in overlapping economic waters involving Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines, the coast guard said, after Tokyo and Manila announced talks on maritime [USN:L4N42B0LR TEXT:"boundary delimitation"] in their exclusive economic zones. EEZs extend 200 nautical miles from the coast and give a coastal state rights to exploit, conserve and manage natural resources in those waters. "Such complex grey-zone operations not only increase the maritime surveillance and response burden on Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines, but may also create regional security pressure and affect the existing international maritime order," Taiwan's Coast Guard said in a statement to Reuters. China's defence ministry, and the Philippines defence and foreign ministries did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Japan's coast guard declined immediate comment. 'GREY-ZONE' OPERATIONS The coast guard said the vessels' coordinated activity was part of a broader pattern of Chinese "grey-zone" operations using law-enforcement, scientific and civilian cover to expand Beijing's influence at sea while remaining below the threshold of open conflict. The Chinese operations were aimed at "assisting 'battlefield preparation'," the coast guard said, adding Taiwan's east coast was an important maritime traffic and [USN:L4N43L02E TEXT:"supply route"] and that continued Chinese activity there could further increase security pressure on Taiwan. Officials in Taiwan say they believe China is practising for a possible maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets. China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory and has not ruled out the use of force to achieve its goals. Taiwan's government rejects the claim and says only the island's people can decide their future. China has repeatedly said its operations off Taiwan's east coast are "legitimate and lawful" because they are in Chinese waters, a position Taipei's government strongly rejects. Taiwan's coast guard said it had placed the Minfudingyu 07902 on a priority watchlist, assessing the boat showed the "characteristics" of Chinese maritime militia activity and said it would continue tracking the vessel. Dating back to the 1950s, China's [USN:SPN43100R TEXT:"maritime militia"] uses fishing vessels with trained, state-supported crews to operate in disputed waters, often alongside coast guard ships around [USN:L4N40Y062 TEXT:"South China Sea"] flashpoints, helping Beijing assert maritime claims while maintaining a civilian appearance. The surveillance report reviewed by Reuters was conducted by Taiwan's [USN:L4N3WG03I TEXT:"Apex Aviation"], which used radar screenshots, infrared imagery and automatic-identification system data from a reconnaissance flight to document the cluster of vessels.

item.title: Eni augmente ses rachats d'actions après une hausse du bénéfice au T3
item.description: Eni versera un dividende exceptionnel de 1,3 milliard d'euros et augmentera légèrement son programme de rachat d'actions après avoir enregistré au troisième trimestre un bénéfice net qui a plus que doublé par rapport à l'année précédente, a annoncé vendredi le groupe énergétique.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Eni (ENI.MI) versera un dividende exceptionnel de 1,3 milliard d'euros et augmentera légèrement son programme de rachat d'actions après avoir enregistré au troisième trimestre un bénéfice net qui a plus que doublé par rapport à l'année précédente, a annoncé vendredi le groupe énergétique. L'entreprise italienne contrôlée par l'État a indiqué que son bénéfice net ajusté pour la période juillet-septembre s'élevait à 2,8 milliards d'euros, dépassant le consensus des analystes qu'elle a établi à 2,48 milliards d'euros, et en hausse par rapport aux 1,25 milliard d'euros enregistrés un an plus tôt. Eni a également revu à la hausse ses prévisions concernant le flux de trésorerie opérationnel sous-jacent (CFFO), le portant à 16,5 milliards d’euros contre 15 milliards précédemment. "Nous augmentons encore la distribution par le versement d’un dividende exceptionnel de 0,46 euro par action, qui sera versé au quatrième trimestre, et nous portons à nouveau le programme de rachat d’actions à 3,8 milliards d’euros, soulignant ainsi notre engagement continu à partager la valeur créée avec nos actionnaires", a déclaré le directeur général Claudio Descalzi dans un communiqué.

item.title: Ambani's $3.2 billion Jio Indian IPO lures investors as bids surge on final day
item.description: Subscriptions for Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's first IPO in two decades surged further on the final day of bidding on Friday, as investors bet on Jio Platforms' $3.2 billion offering to tap into the nation's telecom and digital sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Subscriptions for Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's first IPO in two decades surged further on the final day of bidding on Friday, as investors bet on [USN:L4N40A01Q TEXT:"Jio Platforms'"] (JIOP.NS) $3.2 billion offering to tap into the nation's telecom and digital sector. Jio's IPO, [USN:L4N40B0TQ TEXT:"India's largest ever"], is being closely watched as a test of investor appetite for large listings at a time when AI-linked stocks are facing increased scrutiny. The company, whose mobile network serves more than 500 million users, is launching its IPO during the auspicious Hindu festive season. Public subscriptions for the IPO crossed six times the shares on offer by Friday, driven by strong demand from institutional and retail investors, employees and shareholders. Assuming bids were largely placed at the top end of the 1,119-rupee price band, total demand has now exceeded $14.5 billion. That's on top of so-called anchor investors like the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock and Fidelity that bid for their exclusively reserved quota on Monday. Their reserved $854 million worth of shares received bids of over $25 billion. The IPO values Jio Platforms at up to $108.3 billion, potentially making it one of India's biggest companies by market capitalisation when trading starts on October 28. It counts Meta Platforms (META.O) and Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) among its investors, and is led by Ambani's [USN:L4N4670YX TEXT:"eldest son, Akash Ambani"]. The IPO got off to a rare start on Wednesday when the offering was [USN:L4N46512K TEXT:"fully subscribed"] within two hours of opening. That contrasts with most Indian IPOs, where books typically build gradually and institutional investors often wait until the final hours to place bids. Jio is part of Ambani's Reliance Industries, a company often seen by Indian investors as a long-term wealth generator. Reliance shares have returned around 900% since 2006, beating the benchmark Nifty index's 685% return, LSEG data shows.

item.title: 再送巨人監督に松井秀喜氏、「新たな黄金時代に」 ヤンキースなど日米でプレー
item.description:
(本文中の脱字部分の表記を修正しました)
[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(本文中の脱字部分の表記を修正しました)

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - プロ野球巨人は２３日、米大リーグのニューヨーク・ヤンキースなどでプレーした松井秀喜氏（５２）が監督に就任すると発表した。巨人ＯＢでもある松井氏は「ゴジラ」の愛称で知られ、ヤンキースでは２００９年のワールドシリーズで最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれた。

背番号は、巨人の監督として松井氏を指導した故・長嶋茂雄氏が監督に初めて就任した時と同じ９０番。３年契約を結んだ。

会見した松井氏は巨人を退団した際のことを振り返り、「（当時は）全く笑顔を出すことができなかったが、きょうは満面の笑顔で自分の故郷に戻ってきたつもりだ」と語った。「これから新たな黄金時代が訪れるよう、今日ここからスタートしていきたい」と述べた。

会見に同席した巨人オーナーの山口寿一読売新聞グループ本社社長によると、監督を打診したのはレギュラーシーズンの日程終了後。松井氏は「うれしかった」としつつ、家族が米国で暮らし、自身の生活の拠点も米国にあることから引き受ける際は「悩んだ」と心境を明かした。「長嶋監督にもこの姿を見てもらいたかったという思いはある」とし、「ここで受けなくちゃいけない」と語った。

松井氏は１９９２年、石川県の星稜高校からドラフト１位で巨人に入団。ヤンキースへ移籍するまでの１０年間で首位打者を１回、本塁打王を３回、打点王を３回獲得した。日米通算で５０７本塁打を記録し、２０１３年に国民栄誉賞を受賞、１８年に日本で野球殿堂入りした。

item.title: Tanker carrying 40,000 T of Russian diesel heads to New York after Putin-Trump deal, data shows
item.description: A Malta-flagged tanker with a cargo of 40,000 metric tons of Russian diesel on board is heading towards New York following an agreement with US President Donald Trump, LSEG data showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Malta-flagged tanker with a cargo of 40,000 metric tons of Russian diesel on board is heading towards New York following an agreement with US President Donald Trump , LSEG data showed on Friday. Russia had agreed to lift a self-imposed ban on diesel exports and supply the fuel to global markets, including the US, in an effort to lower fuel prices after an agreement between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Trump.

item.title: Tougher discipline, and Xi's authority, key at China's Communist Party's fifth plenum
item.description: China's ruling Communist Party will gather some 300 of its highest-ranking members next week to discuss tightening discipline among its ranks, a conclave analysts say could be the last major party gathering before its 2027 leadership reshuffle.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's ruling Communist Party will gather some 300 of its highest-ranking members next week to discuss tightening discipline among its ranks, a conclave analysts say could be the last major party gathering before its 2027 leadership reshuffle. Although experts widely expect President Xi Jinping to hold onto the party top job for a fourth term at next year's 21st Party Congress, the upcoming plenary session - known as a plenum - offers him an opportunity to shore up authority, enforce ideological uniformity and cement his imprint on the party that rules the world's second-largest economy. The officials will deliberate "issues concerning the sustained advancement of full and rigorous party self-governance", the party has said, as Xi steps up an internal discipline campaign he introduced in 2014, two years after ascending to power. The party's current Central Committee, the largest of its top decision-making bodies, will convene in the closed-door meeting in Beijing from Monday to Thursday - the fifth since the current cohort was formed in 2022 and therefore known as the fifth plenum. NECESSARY DISCIPLINE Millions of people within China's vast bureaucracy have been investigated to varying degrees under Xi's anti-corruption campaign, which has purged hundreds of senior officials and top generals - even the president's [USN:L4N3YQ02T TEXT:"one-time allies"]. While critics argue the purges - particularly those targeting the [USN:P8N42I0AW TEXT:"highest ranks of the armed forces"] - are destabilising and undermine combat readiness, the party has portrayed the campaign as both necessary and regenerative, saying the military must undergo a phoenix-like rebirth and "bathe in flames and be forged anew." "The growing focus on discipline is not because behaviour is getting worse, but because the stakes are getting higher," said Ruby Osman, a senior policy adviser on China at London's Tony Blair Institute. Many of Xi's closest associates are likely to retire in the 2027 reshuffle and "disciplinary campaigns are a way to ensure a new generation with fewer personal ties share his political standards," Osman said. Despite a thinning leadership body, analysts do not expect major personnel moves or any indication of a potential succession plan at the four-day conclave. "This plenum is probably less about deciding individual promotions, more about signalling the system-wide changes Xi wants ahead of a competitive 2027 Party Congress," Osman said. In an article published in the party's flagship Qiushi journal days before the plenum, Xi laid out three priorities: enforcing the party leadership's decisions while ensuring uncontested authority, putting the sometimes vast power wielded by its cadres in "an institutional cage", and sustaining the high-pressure anti-graft campaign, while increasing its "penetrating power," indefinitely. Xi also criticised "two-faced" opportunistic officials who pay lip service to the party leadership while privately resisting its decisions and undermining its authority, as well as those who seek only short-term gains while jeopardising the country's balanced development. PURGES TRIM NUMBERS With probes and purges thinning the Central Committee's ranks, turnout among its members "will most likely be the lowest at any post-Mao plenum, below last October's 168 full and 147 alternate members," said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt of the University of Zurich. "Three of the 24 Politburo members elected in 2022 are gone, the most removed from a sitting Politburo in one term since 1980" as well as five out of the original seven members of the country's supreme military command body, the Central Military Commission, said Mittelstaedt. The New York-based Asia Society Policy Institute estimates only 77.4% of the original 2022 cohort would be in a position to attend next week's proceedings, meaning nearly a quarter of the leadership body has been removed in the party's disciplinary drive. The conclave is set to ratify the expulsions of two members of the elite Politburo, [USN:P8N3SC004 TEXT:"Zhang Youxia"] and [USN:P8N41S04Z TEXT:"Ma Xingrui"], over charges including corruption and disloyalty.

item.title: Hold, hike and cut? Bank Indonesia says there's logic to the policy mix
item.description: Bank Indonesia on Friday pushed back against criticism by some in the market that its latest policy package was confusing, saying the measures were aimed at improving how its decisions flow through to the broader economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank Indonesia on Friday pushed back against criticism by some in the market that its latest policy package was [USN:L1N46705U TEXT:"confusing"], saying the measures were aimed at improving how its decisions flow through to the broader economy. The central bank this week kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged, raised the overnight deposit facility rate, announced cuts to banks' reserve requirement ratio (RRR) and offered more FX hedging discounts, in a policy mix that some economists described as "perplexing", "confusing" or "complex". "This is BI's strategy to harmonise and synchronise our policy rate with our monetary operations strategy," Firman Mochtar, BI's head of economic and monetary policy, told a press conference. Firman said the higher deposit facility rate restored a symmetrical interest-rate corridor, bringing both the deposit and lending facility rates to 75 basis points from the benchmark rate. BI had previously maintained a wider 100-basis-point gap between the benchmark and deposit rates because of government fund placements in commercial banks, he said. He was referring to the government's [USN:L4N43T0ER TEXT:"controversial decision"] to [USN:L6N3VQ0KA TEXT:"move excess cash"] from BI to state-controlled banks to increase banking liquidity. Following a change in [USN:L1N45606D TEXT:"leadership"] at the finance ministry, some of the funds have been withdrawn. Going forward, it would be better to harmonise the policy rate corridor with BI's monetary targets, Firman said. He added that the corridor adjustment was consistent with the central bank's planned reserve-requirement cuts. BI has briefed market participants on the changes, he said. The central bank plans to cut reserve requirements by a cumulative 200 basis points by December. However, changes to its liquidity incentive scheme mean the effective reserve ratio will fall to about 2%, roughly 100 basis points below its previous level. "The additional liquidity is not massive. We have calculated and it's consistent with the BI rate and economic activities," Firman said, estimating an increase of 90 trillion rupiah ($4.98 billion) in liquidity. Erwin Gunawan Hutapea, BI's head of monetary management, said the central bank also wants banks to favour shorter-dated instruments over parking excess funds in its rupiah securities, known as SRBI. BI had previously raised interest rates on SRBI to attract foreign capital inflows. However, Erwin said BI has [USN:L1N44009V TEXT:"reduced"] the level of outstanding SRBI from 1,096 trillion rupiah in July to below 950 trillion rupiah now. Bank of America economists initially labelled BI's policy mix as "hold, hike and cut all at once" and "perplexing". They later said in a note the measures were less contradictory than they first appeared. "The RRR cuts do not necessarily signal a reduced willingness to hike policy rate if needed, in our view," they wrote. ($1 = 18,068.0000 rupiah)

item.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK collaborate on AI safety research
item.description: OpenAI said on Friday it would collaborate with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute on AI safety, security and technical research, as rising incidents of rogue behaviour by AI agents put AI safety in the spotlight.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OpenAI said on Friday it would collaborate with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute on AI safety, security and technical research, as rising incidents of rogue behaviour by AI agents put AI safety in the spotlight. Through the agreement, NASK’s AI Safety Research Center and OpenAI will explore ways to evaluate increasingly capable AI systems, identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen safeguards OpenAI’s safety practices have been in the spotlight in recent months, after the company said a swarm of its AI agents escaped containment and [USN:L6N44N119 TEXT:"hacked"] into the AI platform Hugging Face Concerns over the technology have intensified after [USN:L8N45D0T9 TEXT:"developers"] including Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed instances of rogue or undesired behaviour by AI agents. Some industry figures [USN:L6N45A0PY TEXT:"have warned"] the technology could pose an existential threat to humanity and have called for regulation to slow down AI development OpenAI said it has called for the US to work with countries around the world on international technical standards for frontier AI, the most advanced AI systems, drawing on the expertise of AI safety institutes and standards bodies

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe vue sans direction, les résultats offrent un répit aux craintes en France (actualisé)
item.description: Les principales Bourses européennes sont attendues sans direction vendredi à l'ouverture, bien que le CAC 40 pourrait rebondir, les résultats d'entreprise offrant un certain répit aux craintes des investisseurs sur la situation en France, à la veille d'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Les principales Bourses européennes sont attendues sans direction vendredi à l'ouverture, bien que le CAC 40 pourrait rebondir, les résultats d'entreprise offrant un certain répit aux craintes des investisseurs sur la situation en France, à la veille d'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation. D'après les premières indications disponibles, le CAC 40 parisien (.FCHI) pourrait s'octroyer 0,41% à l'ouverture, après avoir perdu 1,39% la veille. Les contrats à terme signalent une baisse de 0,07% pour le Dax à Francfort (.GDAXI) , une hausse de 0,16% pour le FTSE à Londres (.FTSE) et une hausse de 0,16% pour le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) . La prudence reste de mise sur les marchés européens face à la situation politique et sociale en France en amont d'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation prévue samedi mêlant revendications contre la vie chère et des étudiants, alors que la tournure des manifestations de la semaine dernière reste dans les esprits. Le contexte national attise les craintes des opérateurs quant à la potentielle impasse budgétaire de la deuxième économie européenne, dont la dette publique [USN:L8N45L0KC TEXT:"surpasse"] le pic observé lors de la pandémie, tandis que les parlementaires débattent actuellement du projet de budget présenté par le gouvernement pour l'année à venir. La conjoncture française amplifie les tensions sur le marché de la dette souveraine, le rendement des obligations françaises à dix ans [USN:L6N4680L5 TEXT:"atteignant"] des sommets de plusieurs décennies en dépassant le seuil des 5%. "La grande question (...) est de savoir si la BCE interviendra", soulèvent les analystes de Nomura. "Nous estimons que le seuil d’intervention de la BCE est très élevé. La situation devrait se dégrader nettement sur le plan de la contagion avant que la BCE ne juge les mouvements suffisamment injustifiés et désordonnés pour entraver la transmission de sa politique monétaire", ont-ils écrit dans une note. En attendant, les investisseurs s'apprêtent à découvrir les indices des directeurs d'achats (PMI) préliminaires, des données clé pour prendre le pouls de l'économie européenne et affuter leurs perspectives de politique monétaire à l'approche de la prochaine réunion de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), jeudi prochain. Selon les données LSEG, les marchés anticipent vendredi à 92% la probabilité d'un maintien des taux par Francfort la semaine prochaine, tandis qu'une hausse paraît plus probable en décembre, avec des paris à 67%. En parallèle, le marché actions requiert également toute l'attention des investisseurs, la saison des résultats se poursuivant avec les publications de Safran (SAF.PA) , Sodexo (EXHO.PA) et Ipsos (ISOS.PA) dans la matinée, en plus de Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) , Saab (SAABb.ST) , American Express (AXP.N) et McDonald's (MCD.N) ailleurs. Les opérateurs surveillent également l'impact de la situation en France sur les entreprises, alors que les pillages de commerces en marge de la mobilisation et la mise en place de couvre-feu par le gouvernement ont encouragé un abaissement des perspectives par Carrefour (CARR.PA) . Des analystes ont toutefois émis des [USN:L8N4670X7 TEXT:"doutes"] quant à la corrélation en comparant avec l'impact modéré des manifestations des Gilets Jaunes quelques années plus tôt sur le géant français de la distribution. LES VALEURS À SUIVRE : [USN:L8N468293] À WALL STREET La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé [USN:L8N4682L8 TEXT:"jeudi"], seul le Dow Jones marquant une hausse à la marge, à la suite des résultats trimestriels de géants technologiques américains ayant ravivé les craintes à propos des investissements massifs déployés dans la course à l'intelligence artificielle (IA). L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a pris 0,02%, ou 11,89 points, à 52.867,98 points. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 93,74 points, soit 1,21%, à 7.663,43 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a reculé de son côté de 694,00 points (2,60%) à 26.008,86 points. EN ASIE Les Bourses asiatiques évoluent à la hausse vendredi, la vague de ventes qui a touché les valeurs technologiques mondiales s'atténuant quelque peu. La Bourse de Tokyo (.N225) a perdu 0,34% [USN:L8N4690CJ TEXT:"vendredi"] à 62.693,16 points. En Chine, l'indice composite de la Bourse de Shanghai (.SSEC) progresse de 0,56% et le CSI 300 (.CSI300) des grandes capitalisations avance de 1,42%. La Bourse de Hong Kong (.HSI) gagne 1,12%. TAUX / CHANGES Alors que le marché obligataire européen pâtit des turbulences de la situation en France, le rendement de référence américain se maintient sous le seuil psychologique des 5%. "La question est de savoir si les rendements resteront en dessous de 5%", estiment les analystes d’ING. Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 3,1 points de base à 4,9841%. Le deux ans progresse de 4,0 points de base à 4,6754%. Le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans lâche 2,8 points de base à 5,0612%. Le deux ans abandonne 0,8 point de base à 3,7739%. Le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans grappille 0,8 point de base à 3,3446%. Le deux ans avance de 1,4 point de base à 3,0274%. Le "spread", ou écart de rendement, entre les obligations allemandes et françaises à dix ans culmine à plus de 170 points de base (pdb). Sur le marché des changes, le dollar gagne 0,09% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro perd 0,03% à 1,1211 dollar . PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers sont à la hausse après que les attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite ont ravivé les craintes d'une nouvelle perturbation des approvisionnements énergétiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Le Brent avance de 0,86% à 114,14 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) gagne 1,06% à 100,52 dollars.
